messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "increase dose to 7 mg once daily after 30 days on 3 mg dose"
set: ["increase dose to 7 mg once daily after 30 days on 3 mg dose", "after 30 days on the 1.5 mg dose, increase the dose to 4 mg once daily", "requirement applies after at least 30 days on 7 mg dose", "start with 3 mg once daily for 30 days", "increase occurs after at least 30 days on the 4 mg dose", "30 mg once daily", "3 mg once daily", "1.5 mg once daily for 30 days", "increase total daily dose by 50 mg every 3 days as tolerated", "3 to 7 days", "start with 1.5 mg once daily for 30 days", "dose may be increased to 9 mg once daily", "dose may be increased to 14 mg once daily", "600 mg orally once each morning on days 1 to 3", "40 mg orally twice daily for 7 days", "increase dosage to 0.5 mg once weekly after 4 weeks on 0.25 mg"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
